should_fix.description: Performance concern: aggregate_impact calls find_related() with limit=1000 for each input file (up to 500). Worst case 500x1000=500,000 intermediate results in HashMap.
should_fix.reason: Memory and CPU concern for large git diff outputs. Consider documenting expected scale or adding progressive limit.

should_fix.description: Duplicate validation logic: validate_file_paths (cli/mod.rs) vs validate_file_path (cli/stdin.rs) with different error types and slightly different checks
should_fix.reason: Maintenance risk from two overlapping validation functions. Bug fix in one might not propagate to the other.

should_fix.description: E2E test impact_excludes_input_files_from_results checks wrong JSON field name (f['path'] vs 'file_path')
should_fix.reason: Test assertion is vacuously true. Same issue as Stage 1 S3.

nice_to_have.description: Impact JSON uses pretty-printed format while other subcommands use compact JSONL
relation_type_to_string duplicates mapping logic found in human.rs and json.rs
nice_to_have.reason: Three places map RelationType to strings. A centralized Display impl would reduce divergence.

nice_to_have.description: ImpactResult derives Serialize but format_impact_json manually constructs JSON
nice_to_have.reason: Unused Serialize derive. Either use it or remove it.

summary: LOW RISK to existing functionality. Changes are purely additive. No existing tests broken. Main concerns: (1) E2E test field name bug (S3, same as Stage 1), (2) duplicate validation logic, (3) performance at scale. No new dependencies.
